get.summary: Find best-matching restraint video for crash conditions
get.description:
Return the best-matching restraint video for the given crash parameters.

Resolution order for seat-position zone:
1. `seat_x_mm` query parameter (explicit value from HMI)
2. Latest SPS_FL/FR_SeatDirectionX value in SignalStore
3. Fallback default from seat identifier (fl / fr → mid)

Resolution order for occupant percentile:
1. Latest OMS_FL/FR_OccupantClassification value in SignalStore
   (class 0/1/2 maps to video bucket 5p/50p/95p)
2. Weight-derived percentile from `weight` parameter

SignalStore values are accepted without a receive-freshness or provenance check, so
an initial DBC-seeded value or stale value can take priority over request parameters.

parameters.name: height

schema.description: Occupant height in cm (recorded for reference)
schema.title: Height

parameters.description: Occupant height in cm (recorded for reference)

parameters.name: seat_x_mm

schema.description: Seat travel distance in mm from SPS_SeatDirectionX (0 mm = frontmost / closest to instrument panel, 227 mm = rearmost). If omitted the backend reads the latest SignalStore value. Zone mapping: front 0–56.75 mm, mid 56.75–170.25 mm, rear ≥170.25 mm.
schema.title: Seat X Mm

parameters.description: Seat travel distance in mm from SPS_SeatDirectionX (0 mm = frontmost / closest to instrument panel, 227 mm = rearmost). If omitted the backend reads the latest SignalStore value. Zone mapping: front 0–56.75 mm, mid 56.75–170.25 mm, rear ≥170.25 mm.
